grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: My Daily Routine
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. My name is Li Ming. I am a student. I live in Beijing. I get up at six thirty. I have breakfast at seven. I go to school at seven thirty. I walk to school.

B. I have four classes in the morning. I have lunch at twelve. In the afternoon, I have two classes. I go home at four thirty. I have dinner at six thirty. I go to bed at nine thirty.

C. I like sports. I play basketball on Saturdays. I swim on Sundays. I do not play basketball on Mondays.

questions.explanation: 原文明确说“I get up at six thirty.”，所以选“At six thirty.”。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty.

questions.explanation: 原文说“I walk to school.”，即步行去学校，所以选“He walks.”。
原文说“I have four classes in the morning.”，所以上午有四节课。
questions.evidence: I have four classes in the morning.

questions.explanation: 原文说“I have lunch at twelve.”，所以午饭时间是十二点。
原文说“I go home at four thirty.”，所以回家时间是四点半。
questions.evidence: I go home at four thirty.

questions.explanation: 原文说“I go to bed at nine thirty.”，所以睡觉时间是九点半。
questions.evidence: I go to bed at nine thirty.

questions.prompt: 李明星期几打篮球？请用原文中的词填空。
questions.explanation: 原文说“I play basketball on Saturdays.”，所以填Saturdays。

questions.prompt: 李明星期几游泳？请用原文中的词填空。
questions.explanation: 原文说“I swim on Sundays.”，所以填Sundays。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形，不加 -s。例如：I walk to school. 否定形式在动词前加 do not，例如：I do not play basketball on Mondays.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 walk，所以选“I walk to school.”。
主语是 we，动词用原形 have，所以选“We have lunch at twelve.”。
主语是 they，动词用原形 play，所以选“They play basketball on Saturdays.”。
主语是 you，动词用原形 swim，所以选“You swim on Sundays.”。
